text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much for giving me 
yesterday off.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san, Nakayama-san, Orfe, and I all 
got together... and had a lot of fun."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
All I will say is that it's a game for 
four players... I shall leave the rest to 
your imagination.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, what was done is not particularly 
important.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To me, those moments spent together with 
everyone are truly irreplaceable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Dream Journey got plenty of rest.
